purpose: Teach: 浮遊/社会民主党/脱走/懲罰/移送/送還/駆逐/政務

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場に浮遊する微粒子の証拠を警察、採取されてますね
lines.en: The police have collected evidence of the fine particles suspended at the scene, haven't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured inquiry. Soft questioning lilt at the end. Pause before 「ですね」—not challenging, but seeking confirmation. Intellectual curiosity without pressure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、社会民主党所属の議員からの陳情にも対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to petitions from Diet members, including those from the Social Democratic Party.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Each clause lands with quiet precision. No inflection—the facts speak. Professional distance maintained throughout, eye contact level and direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の脱走を警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: The police are keeping close watch on the suspect's potential escape, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle probing. Slight pause before the tag question, as if thinking through the implications. Respectful uncertainty—checking assumptions rather than pressing. Soft trailing-off.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正職員への懲罰を厳格に行います
lines.en: The police will conduct disciplinary action against any misconduct staff with strict standards.
lines.style: Firm, formal declaration. Emphasis on 「厳格に」—resolve without harshness. Measured cadence. The tone of someone speaking both to the moment and to the record.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の移送を警察、ご担当ですね
lines.en: The police are handling the suspect's transfer, is that correct?
lines.style: Quiet deference combined with gentle verification. The inflection stays level—not seeking permission, but acknowledging the officer's domain. Respectful subordinate position in the dialogue.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法滞在者の送還手続きを進めます
lines.en: The police will proceed with the repatriation procedures for those in illegal status.
lines.style: Clear, procedural. Controlled tone—no emotion, no judgment. Facts stated as sequence of necessary actions. Shoulders back, voice steady and official.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織的犯罪駆逐の作戦を警察、立てられてますね
lines.en: The police have developed a strategy to root out organized crime, haven't they?
lines.style: Respectful inquiry with subtle admiration. Slight warmth entering the voice for the first time. Genuine question seeking insight into the scale of the operation. Less distance than before.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、政務に関わる事案にも誠実に対応します
lines.en: The police will respond with sincerity to all matters, including those with political dimensions.
lines.style: Composed, measured closing statement. Emphasis on 「誠実に」—a quiet moral stance. Slight softening at the end, as if closing the interview with grace. Voice remains steady but gains quiet conviction.
